row.evidence: Wrike's SCIM API help article lists availability as "Pinnacle, Apex" and unavailability as "Free, Team, Business"; the pricing page shows Pinnacle and Apex as "Contact us".
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated). Plans since 21 Jan 2026: Free $0, Team $10, Business $25 per user/month billed annually, Pinnacle and Apex Contact us. SCIM (Okta, OneLogin and Entra apps plus a documented generic SCIM API) and SAML SSO are Pinnacle/Apex (and Legacy Enterprise). SCIM uses a permanent API token; SSO is recommended but not required (users created without SAML set a password via reset). Deprovisioning deactivates the user: they are logged out everywhere but the user still takes a licence seat; deletion frees the seat. Users added via SCIM are billable immediately. The REST API v4 is free on every plan; the Audit Log API is for Enterprise admins.

auth.token_source: Apps & Integrations > API > create app > Create Token (permanent API token); SCIM URL from the SCIM tab of the Okta / OneLogin / Azure AD card
auth.notes: Docs call it a permanent API/OAuth token; SCIM 2.0 version inferred from the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:wrike:2.0 extension URN (c30).

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users keep all items, sharing and access level; they are logged out on all devices and still take a licence seat. SCIM DELETE removes the user permanently (frees the seat, cannot be restored).

custom.how: User custom fields via urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:wrike:2.0:User:{customFieldId}_{title}; wrikeUserType sets the user type

attributes.notes: Entra/Okta articles list Organization and Department as synced attributes without naming the schema; placed under enterprise by convention. Group attribute names are not spelled out in text.

roles.how: wrikeUserType attribute (Regular, External, Collaborator, Viewer, Contributor) or user type UIDs

limitations.text: Sync is one way only, from the IdP to Wrike.
SCIM search supports only email address (userName eq).
Only users from approved domains are provisioned.
Okta Import Groups is not supported.
Users added through SCIM are billable as soon as they are provisioned.
Deactivated users still take a licence seat.

capabilities.notes: assign_roles: Modify User (admin) with user types (c49); exact fields not checked.

endpoints.purpose: List contacts of all users and user groups

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook docs list task, folder and approval events; no user events found.

audit_log_api.plan: Enterprise admins with 'Create user activity reports' right

rate_limits.text: Approximately 400 requests per minute (per-second based); 429 on excess.

okta.notes: OIN markup checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push.

google.notes: Pricing tooltip says SSO works with Google apps; no Google provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: From Wrike's OneLogin guide; OneLogin page not loaded.
